specialty.name: +1 Sulfur
specialty.description:
Increases kingdom's sulfur production by {+1} per day.

{Additionally}: once per week, each {Resource Silo} automatically grants its bonus only to the first visiting rare-resource production specialist: {+5} of each resource produced by the visited {Resource Silo}.
specialty.tooltip: {+1} sulfur per day; once per week, the first rare-resource specialist receives {+5} of each resource from the visited {Resource Silo}.
